title: Affine Volterra covariance processes and application to commodity markets
abstract: arXiv:2609.24548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study affine stochastic Volterra equations on the cone of symmetric positive semidefinite matrices. For scalar kernels acting entrywise on the matrix dynamics, we establish weak existence by exploiting stochastic invariance results for Volterra equations on convex domains and derive a conditional Fourier--Laplace transform formula characterized by matrix-valued Riccati--Volterra equations. As an application, we extend the Gibson--Schwartz commodity model by replacing its variance-covariance structure with a Volterra--Wishart process. The resulting model allows for memory in the variances and for stochastic instantaneous correlation, while retaining affine tractability. Its joint Fourier--Laplace transform admits an exponential-affine representation governed by a matrix Riccati--Volterra equation. While the existence theory considered here excludes kernels that are singular at the origin, shifted fractional kernels remain admissible

translated_title: 仿射Volterra协方差过程及其在大宗商品市场中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究对称半正定矩阵锥上的仿射随机Volterra方程。对于在矩阵动态上逐元素作用的标量核，我们利用凸区域上Volterra方程的随机不变性结果建立了弱存在性，并推导出由矩阵值Riccati--Volterra方程刻画的条件Fourier--Laplace变换公式。作为应用，我们通过用Volterra--Wishart过程替换其方差-协方差结构来扩展Gibson--Schwartz大宗商品模型。所得模型允许方差具有记忆性以及随机瞬时相关性，同时保持仿射可处理性。其联合Fourier--Laplace变换具有由矩阵Riccati--Volterra方程支配的指数仿射表示。虽然本文考虑的存在性理论排除了在原点处奇异的核，但平移分数核仍然是可容许的。
tldr: 本文建立了对称半正定矩阵锥上仿射随机Volterra方程的弱存在性理论与条件Fourier-Laplace变换公式，并据此用Volterra-Wishart过程扩展Gibson-Schwartz大宗商品模型，实现了方差记忆性与随机瞬时相关性的仿射可处理建模。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes weak existence and conditional Fourier-Laplace transform formulas for affine stochastic Volterra equations on the cone of symmetric positive semidefinite matrices, and applies the theory to extend the Gibson-Schwartz commodity model with a Volterra-Wishart process, capturing memory in variances and stochastic instantaneous correlation while retaining affine tractability.
